t: Time 3093Y white flexible cable delivers reliable performance for small appliances rated up to 6A. This 10m coil provides a compact 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The heat-resistant PVC sheath withstands operating temperatures from -15°C to 90°C, whilst 24 strands per core ensure superior flexibility and durability for demanding appliance connections. Ideal for trade installations requiring dependable, hardwearing cable solutions for light-duty household appliances and portable equipment.
